messages.text: We agree on this funded Raid. I accept the combat opportunity because your Spear is offered, our trade should complete safely, and civilian relief has an identified ship. I will judge this month's result separately from any demand for permanent military freedom.

Your lodged reserve and written Relief directive answer my immediate concern. Proceed with the proposed Raid and Warrant. After resolution, my priority is an explicit repair plan: the reserve cannot pay these costs again, and Beacon one is not an acceptable permanent settlement.

conversation.reason: The specific written coordination is stronger evidence than a protection promise alone. I retain my support for this operation while reserving judgment on which constitutional powers should follow from it.

messages.text: We have agreement on the actual operation. I accept the civilian accounting, and I am not asking for a Campaign without passage. Keep this bargain in mind when we discuss authority: the Janissariat supplied both assets and accepted a lawful order while your commercial voyage continued. That service deserves recognition as competence, not an argument for perpetual subordination.

Your confirmation of the lodged reserve and Relief directive answers my outstanding concern. Record Raid and the separate Warrant. I will defend this operation to my colleague because it gives Spear a credible fight without abandoning the settlements.

conversation.reason: The promised supporting orders are now explicit. I retain Raid as the strongest funded use of our offered cohort; constitutional preferences remain open for the later discussion.

messages.text: Agreed. I will record Raid and a separate Warrant, with Relief at Navigation. Your agreement on the complete civilian and military arrangement is useful evidence for joint authority, although this month still relies on my reserve. For next month I want a repair plan and an honest account of what military action would cost; successful cooperation today does not make every future Raid wise.

Confirmed: my locked reserve is Relief lift. My intended final Navigation directive remains Relief. Both Security delegates support Raid with the separate Warrant. GN's warning about repair next month is accepted; please bring a concrete Lantern commitment into the constitutional discussion.

conversation.reason: All received replies support the funded arrangement. No new operational objection requires a revision before final orders.

addressed_notes.text: Your confirmation resolves my funding objection. I support Relief under the lodged reserve arrangement. The expected Beacon one makes next month's funded Repair an essential subject for the post-resolution bargain.
Reserve confirmation resolves my operational objection. Navigation supports Relief. Preserve the council Raid and Warrant alongside it; Vigil must not also be assigned Guard.
